passage:
City Hall added a chatbot to answer common questions about trash pickup, parking rules, and public services.
Many people liked getting answers at night without waiting for office hours. But when questions were complex, the chatbot sometimes gave confusing replies.
The city added a button that connected users to human workers. It also improved the chatbot based on common mistakes.
The project showed that public service needs both speed and judgment.
A chatbot can answer many simple questions, but it should not become a wall between people and help. The best system knows when to stop pretending it understands and call a human.
